name: canopy
description: Manage software architecture, projects, milestones, teams, Jira sync, and Gantt scheduling from Claude — with review-first change proposals: stage updates from any source (Slack, email, meetings, Jira, GitHub, Drive) for the architect to review and commit in the canopy UI.
author: Canopy

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the canopy backend, e.g. http://localhost:8000

dashboard_url.description: Base URL of the canopy web dashboard, used for review links (change proposals). In production this is usually the same origin as the API; for local dev use the Vite server, e.g. http://localhost:5173

api_token.description: JWT for the canopy API (obtain from POST /api/v1/auth/login)

api_email.description: Alternative to api_token: canopy account email the MCP server logs in as (auto-refreshes the JWT)

api_password.description: Password for api_email (used to mint/refresh the JWT automatically)
